name: Foundations
blurb: The tensor-level things you are expected to write on a whiteboard: attention, tokenizers, decoding.

name: Retrieval
blurb: Chunking, lexical scoring, fusion, re-ranking. Everything between a document and a context window.

name: LLM Plumbing
blurb: Retries, streams, rate limits, structured output. The code that decides whether your app survives a Tuesday.

name: Agents
blurb: Loops, budgets, tool schemas, memory. An agent is control flow, and this is that control flow.

name: Evals & Safety
blurb: Scoring, judging, redacting, detecting. You cannot ship what you cannot measure.
